title: Terms & conditions
summary: How ordering, Mobile Money payment, delivery, returns and refunds work at Exia Organics.
body:
These terms apply when you use this website or buy from Exia Organics ("we", "us"). Please read them before you order. By placing an order, you agree to them. They sit alongside our [privacy policy](/privacy), which explains how we look after your details.

Nothing in these terms takes away the rights you have as a consumer under Ghanaian law.

## Our products

Our products are handmade haircare and cosmetics for external use on the hair and scalp. They are not medicines, and nothing on this website, including our journal and tutorials, is medical advice.

- **Check the ingredients** on each product page before you buy, especially if you have allergies.
- **Patch test first.** Apply a little to a small area of skin and wait 24 hours before using a new product fully. Stop using it if irritation develops.
- If you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have a scalp condition, ask a doctor before use.
- Keep products out of reach of children and away from the eyes.

Because our products are handmade, colour, scent and texture can vary slightly between batches. Photos show the product as closely as we can, but screens differ.

## Prices and promotions

- Prices are in Ghana cedis (GHS). Delivery is charged separately (see Delivery below).
- A sale price applies until the end date shown, or while stocks last. Promotions can't be swapped for cash and, unless we say otherwise, can't be combined.
- If we make a mistake with a price or product description, we'll contact you before dispatching. You can then go ahead at the correct price, or cancel and receive a full refund.

## How ordering works

1. You add products to your cart and fill in your details at checkout.
2. You pay the total by Mobile Money to the number shown at checkout ({momoNumber}, {momoName}), quoting your order reference (EXA-…) in the payment note.
3. You enter your MoMo transaction ID and place the order.
4. We check the payment against our MoMo account. **Your order is confirmed only once we have received your payment** and we let you know by phone or WhatsApp.

Placing an order is an offer to buy. We may decline or cancel an order, for example if an item has sold out, the payment can't be found, or the details look fraudulent. If we cancel after you've paid, we refund you in full.

Only send money to the MoMo number shown at checkout. We will never ask for your MoMo PIN, and we're not responsible for payments sent to any other number.

## Delivery

- We deliver to the address you give at checkout. Please make sure it, and your phone number, are correct and that someone can receive the order.
- The delivery fee is either shown at checkout for your area, or agreed with you on WhatsApp before dispatch.
- Delivery times we give are estimates. We'll keep you updated if there's a delay.
- If a delivery fails because the address was wrong or no one was available, we may need to charge for another delivery attempt.

## Cancellations, returns and refunds

- **Changed your mind before dispatch?** Contact us as soon as possible and we'll cancel the order and refund you in full.
- **Damaged, faulty or wrong item?** Tell us within 48 hours of delivery, with a photo, and we'll replace it or refund you.
- **Unopened items** can be returned within 7 days of delivery, in their original sealed condition. You pay the cost of returning them.
- For hygiene reasons, we can't accept returns of products that have been opened or used, unless they are faulty.
- Refunds are paid by Mobile Money to the number that paid for the order, usually within 3 working days of us approving them.

To start a return or refund, call or WhatsApp us on {phone}, or email {email}, quoting your order reference.

## Using this website

- Please use this website lawfully and don't try to disrupt it or access parts of it you're not meant to.
- The words, photos, videos and designs on this website belong to Exia Organics. Please don't copy them for commercial use without our permission. You're welcome to share links to our pages.
- We link to some other websites, such as WhatsApp, TikTok and YouTube. We aren't responsible for their content or how they work.
- We work to keep the website available and accurate, but we can't promise it will always be uninterrupted or error-free.

## Our responsibility to you

If we break these terms, we're responsible for loss or damage you suffer that was a foreseeable result. Otherwise, to the extent the law allows, our responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. We don't limit our responsibility where it would be unlawful to do so, including for injury caused by our negligence.

We're not responsible for reactions caused by using a product against the directions on its label or page, or for delays caused by events outside our control.

## Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The version on this page when you place your order is the one that applies to that order.

## Law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Ghana, and the courts of Ghana deal with any disputes. We'd always rather sort things out with you directly first.
